verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe scheduling recurring tasks that run in the background, with a Scheduled view for active, paused, and completed tasks and recent runs (docs-11, docs-37). Scheduled tasks can also be triggered by Gmail, Slack, or GitHub events (docs-12, docs-26, docs-47), and the Codex SDK automates coding jobs in CI (docs-91). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled tasks work reliably.
